remarks: Welcome to 100 West! Looking for a chic and newer constructed home, centrally located and full of amenities? This pristine and beautifully upgraded, 3 bedroom 2 bath condo offers all that and more. Single story layout flooded with light and on the top level so no one is above you, with spacious living room, modern kitchen, dining room, and private deck. Tastefully designed with beautiful quartz counters, luxury vinyl plank flooring, plush carpeting, with an in-unit washer/dryer. Primary suite w/ en-suite bathroom, secondary and third bedroom, with a large full bathroom with a walk in shower in the hallway accessible to guests. Open concept kitchen with large island and refrigerator included
